# The AI Runtime (SPM package: multimodal-coordinator; modules: MultiModalKit…)

> Names, once: the package and modules keep their birth names because two apps pin them; `AIRuntime` is the front door's type; "the AI Runtime" is the name of the whole (D-115). A major version renames package and modules together, when the runtime can do everything the name claims.

> An on-device voice assistant for iOS/macOS in three organs — ear (speech to text), mind (a language model), mouth (text to speech) — and a coordinator that runs the turn loop with barge-in. Swift 6, strict concurrency, zero runtime dependencies in the core module. Apache-2.0. Nothing leaves the device after the weights are on disk.

## Read this first
- docs/INTEGRATE.md — the quick starts (mind, weights, admission, tools, the voice loop), the ten rules, and the generated public API surface. Start here.
- README.md — what this is, the concurrency model, the hardest problem, how to build and test.
- llms.txt (this file) — the map.

## The contract pages (one per milestone, fact-checked against the source)
- ARCHITECTURE.md § "The mind's text contract (4v)" — reply(to:), GenerationOptions, StopReason, ReplyFailure, MindReadiness.
- ARCHITECTURE.md § "Getting the weights (4x)" — expectedInstall(), download(reporting:), InstallState, WeightsFetching, the privacy manifests.
- ARCHITECTURE.md § "Model downloads (5a)" — ModelBacked's five questions, ModelDownloader on a background session, ModelDownloads.handleEvents, what a stopped transfer keeps, what a delete removes.
- ARCHITECTURE.md § "Running it safely (4y)" — admit(needing:), heat at the door, memory pressure, the deadline, what is measured.
- ARCHITECTURE.md § "The tool contract (4z)" — ReplyTool with typed parameters, the door (strip → check → band → flag → shield → cap → words), tools per call, the confirmation flag, what each mind shows the model.
- ARCHITECTURE.md § "Where is …? — the geography table" — file for every seam.

## The record (the repo is the memory)
- SPEC.md — every milestone's scope, acceptance criteria (AC-nnn) and test matrix; §198 is 4z's results, §206 is 5a's.
- DECISIONS.md — every ruling (D-nnn) with the options it rejected; D-110 is the tool contract's thirteen forks, D-114 the downloads' eight (and the reversal of D-106's F-2 and F-3).
- INSTRUMENTS.md — every measurement with its methodology; §67 the tool spike, §68 memory under a cut, §69 the tool contract's cost and accuracy, §70 what a download costs and what a resume pays.
- COMMANDS.md — the instruments and demos (`swift run bakeoff …`), and how to run the tests.
- docs/HOSTS.md — the two hosts a download may contact, and what a request carries.
- docs/evidence/<milestone>/ — raw logs: red tests, mutation runs, the 20× loops.

## Tags
- 0.1.0 (e7993b4) the text contract · 0.2.0 (ee6788c) the install and the tool spike · 0.3.0 (228b7e6) admission, heat, and the tool contract · 0.3.1 model downloads (a percentage, a background transfer that resumes, a delete — on every engine). Pin an exact tag; `git show <tag>` lists every public break versus the one before.

## Rules for an agent working near this library
- Requirements come as documents; code comes from this repository's own owner session. Do not push branches here from another project's session.
- Design forks are the owner's to rule: present options with trade-offs and one recommendation; never decide one.
- SPEC first, then tests (red before green, waits on events never on time), then code; 20× before a test phase is done; never rewrite history.
- Both generator inits throw; GenerationOptions.tools nil ≠ .empty; a number is a number (one ToolValue case); isRequired and requiresConfirmation have no default; the confirmation "yes" binds to a tool NAME.
- Measured claims live in INSTRUMENTS.md; a Mac number is the shape, the phone decides.
